news.title: Major QoL Update to Popular Alliance Quest in WoW: Forever
news.description: In WoW: Forever, an iconic quest has received some major quality-of-life updates to allow players to complete this quest faster!
news.details:
In WoW: Forever, the iconic Alliance quest, The Attack!, has received some major quality-of-life updates, allowing players to complete this quest with much less frustration and downtime.
Prior to WoW: Forever, players starting this quest would automatically trigger the event, and only players nearby in that person's party would be able to accept the quest with them. In WoW: Forever, there is an additional dialogue option after starting the quest to make sure everyone in your party is ready!
Along with that, players can now pick up the quest and share it even as the event is happening. In Classic WoW, anyone interested in doing this quest would have to wait for the event to be completed before they and their party could start, often causing long queues and lines as players got to this quest chain. news.title: New Battle.net Icons for WoW: Forever
news.description: New WoW: Forever icons have been added to Battle.net!
news.details:
On the Battle.net launcher, players can click on their icon to change it. From this menu, players can filter by game and choose from many available icons, which now include the new WoW: Forever ones!
Four new icons are available featuring the Undead Paladin, Dwarf Shaman and the Skyborne from the WoW: Forever Key art!

news.title: Four New Key Art Pieces for WoW: Forever Launch
news.description: Blizzard has released beautiful new artwork for the WoW: Forever launch!
news.details:
With the launch of WoW: Forever, Blizzard has released four new Key Art pieces highlighting prominent new features.
Campfire
Camping is a brand new system in WoW: Forever that incentivizes people to slow down, get some buffs and socialize around a campfire!
Dwarf Shaman
Dwarf Shamans are a new race-class combo in WoW: Forever!
Forsaken Paladin
Forsaken Paladins are a new race-class combo in WoW: Forever!
Skyborne
The Skyborne launch key art features the Taldramir, the Whispering Wood legendary!

news.title: Every Quest for Dungeons up to Level 20 in WoW: Forever
news.description: Dungeons are a great source of experience, but only if you have dungeon quests. Here's where to find all the dungeon quests for the first few dungeons.
news.details:
Every Dungeon Quest Location
In WoW: Forever, base dungeon experience from killing mobs has been nerfed, but experience from completing dungeon quests has been buffed. Completing Dungeon Quests is very important, as without them, you won't be getting all the possible experience (or even the majority of it) from a given dungeon.
Below, you'll find the available quests for every dungeon, where to pick them up, the estimated amount of time to get them, and any prerequisite questing that you need to do. Many of these quests are shareable, so if one person in the group has it, they can share it with the rest of the party!

news.title: Minimum Deposit of 1 Silver Required to List Items on Auction House in WoW: Forever
news.description: In WoW: Forever, listing an item on the Auction House always incurs a deposit of at least 1 silver.
news.details:
When players list an item on the Auction House, a deposit is required. The deposit is given back to players if the item successfully sells, but is lost if the item is cancelled or the Auction expires. In the original version of WoW, the deposit requirement depends on the item's Vendor Price and the duration:
DurationDeposit Cost
2 Hours5% of Vendor Price
8 Hours20% of Vendor Price
24 Hours60% of Vendor Price
Vendor Price of 4 Silver and 61 Copper
In WoW: Forever, there appears to be one more rule: A minimum of 1 Silver is required.
With a Vendor price of 4 Silver and 61 Copper, we would expect an 8-hour listing of this item to require 92 Copper, but this is listed at 1 Silver. Similarly, if you take any cheap vendor item, the Deposit is always listed as 1 Silver. This increased deposit imposes a significant risk to players if the item doesn't sell within the time frame. news.title: Blizzard Investigating Issues with Certain Escort Quests in WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard is investigating issues with certain quests in WoW: Forever.
news.details:
BlizzardCS has started writing comments on Wowhead quest pages, noting that certain quests are bugged and that they're investigating the issue.
Escort Quests
BlizzardCS has commented on the quest pages of Freedom to Ruul, Free From the Hold, and The Defias Brotherhood. These are all escort quests that can immediately fail if the quest giver dies or, in this case, despawns.
Blizzard
We're aware that Ruul/Gilthares Firebough/Defias Traitor may disappear when moving near or across zone and area boundaries, causing the quest to fail. We're already investigating the issue.
Undead Paladin Quest
One of the early Undead Paladin quests is Rediscovering the Light, which requires players to rediscover how to use Holy Light. Sometimes healing the NPCs doesn't give progress towards the quest objective and Blizzard is aware of the issue.

news.title: New Prerequisites Required for Ruins of Lordaeron Dungeon Quests in WoW: Forever
news.description: Two Horde quests for Ruins of Lordaeron have new prerequisite quests on live servers!
news.details:
Ruins of Lordaeron DungeonAll Dungeon Quests
Dungeon quests are a very good source of experience in WoW: Forever, as the experience from killing dungeon mobs was nerfed and the amount of experience from dungeon quests were buffed. Ruins of Lordaeron is the second dungeon Horde players are likely to run and when collecting the Dungeon quests, there's a change on the live servers: two of the Horde quests now have a quest chain prerequisite in order to pick them up.
While Alliance players don't have any prerequisites to pick up their quests, The Wrath of Rath'mael and The New Plague now both require a quest chain to be completed when they were previously available right away on Beta.

news.title: The Weekly Reset with Taliesin and Evitel: Forever Forever? Talebound and More
news.description: Taliesin and Evitel check out WoW: Forever, where it's going, and how it's different from Retail. Also Talebound, decor, and more.
news.details:
Taliesin and Evitel cover the latest news and do a deep dive into pertinent topics in The Weekly Reset. This week, WoW: Forever, where it's going, and how it is different from Retail. Also Talebound, decor, and more.
World of Warcraft Forever launches THIS WEEK! It's going to be an amazing time, a clean slate, a new path... but where will that path lead? If Forever does indeed last for forever, the game is inevitably going to change, so what will it look like in a year? 5 years? 10?
We talk horizontal progression, expansions, and playable races. We look forward to the biggest WoW launch ever, and even find time to talk a bit about Midnight and Talebound too!
